messages:
marie: Heads-up — ran into a batch problem for GovCloud invoices from last night. 4 accounts had their reserved-discount lines dropped (zeroed) and one account got a duplicate invoice number. Example: account acme-gov, invoice INV-2026-0589 shows reserved line amount 0.00, then there is a second invoice INV-2026-0589-1 for the same period. export_job_id=exp:gov-20270401-07

samir: ugh. saw a sandbox run earlier with a mapping warning, maybe related. any stack traces in the export logs?

marie: log snippet attached in the job output: 
```
2026-04-01T07:12:03Z [ERROR] mapping failed for sku reserved-gpu -> NoMappingFound
2026-04-01T07:12:03Z [WARN] fallback disabled for region govcloud
2026-04-01T07:12:03Z [INFO] invoice write completed (partial) job=exp:gov-20270401-07
```

luis: paging @samir @jen. We recently changed the producer to emit `reservation_sku` alias for non-global regions. Export reads the mapping table keyed by `sku` and has no fallback for govcloud. Looks like the producer and export schema drifted.

jen: Confirmed — the producer PR switches the payload to `reservation_sku` and we rolled it to gov yesterday. Export code expects `sku` or `sku_alias`. Gov export manifest still uses old mapping file.

billing-bot: job exp:gov-20270401-07 FAILED error_code=MAP_MISSING retries=2 timestamp=2026-04-01T07:15:00Z

elaine: What's the blast radius? Which customers + invoices? We need to stop automated finalization if the export was partial.

marie: current list (from quick query): acme-gov, zephyr-gov, cloudshop-gov, greenco-gov. Also found a duplicate invoice id for acme-gov. I can paste IDs in a follow-up.

luis: immediate mitigation: enable mapping fallback in the export job so it looks for `reservation_sku` and `reserved_gpu` aliases. Then re-run export for job exp:gov-20270401-07 with `--reconcile` to regenerate missing lines. That should reissue corrected invoices and mark duplicates void.

samir: agree. I can push a one-line hotfix to export that checks both fields and deploy to staging now. If tests pass I'll push to prod and re-run.

jen: note: re-run must be idempotent. Use `--idempotent=true` flag, and DO NOT auto-send invoices until finance signs off. We previously had a case where re-issuing created a second PDF and triggered payment processor double notifications.

marie: action items:
- samir: hotfix export mapping (ETA 30m)
- luis: prepare re-run command + reconcile script and a list of affected invoice IDs (ETA 45m)
- jen: add gating so reissue keeps previous invoices in draft until manual approval (ETA 2h)
- elaine: hold off account-notify step and prepare customer comms draft (ETA 1h)

billing-bot: task create ticket=BILL-7621 assignee=samir priority=high

samir: pushing small patch now -> `git push origin fix/gov-sku-fallback` then deploying to prod via `deploy billing-export --region gov --tag hotfix-gov-20270401`

luis: re-run command (dry-run first):
```
./bin/billing-export --job exp:gov-20270401-07 --region gov --reconcile --idempotent=true --dry-run
```
When dry-run looks good, drop `--dry-run` and keep `--idempotent=true`.

marie: I'll compile the full list and drop into BILL-7621. If anyone finds other regions with similar schema drift, add them to the ticket.

elaine: thanks. once we have corrected invoices in draft let's do a quick review before sending. :white_check_mark:

samir: deployed hotfix to prod mapping fallback. running dry-run now.

jen: also adding a unit test to assert export tolerates both `sku` and `reservation_sku` fields. will open PR.

luis: good call. after reconcile we'll run a targeted smoke test against payment webhook so no duplicate notifications go out.

marie: update: dry-run produced corrected line items for the 4 accounts, duplicate invoice flagged for voiding. holding on final reissue pending manual approval from finance.

elaine: I'll review the invoice drafts in an hour. thanks everyone.

samir: closing deploy channel — will post final status in BILL-7621 when reissue completes.
